name: GLI family zinc finger 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: GLI2 encodes transcription activator GLI2 [Cleaved into: Transcription repressor GLI2R]. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to holoprosencephaly 9 (autosomal dominant); postaxial polydactyly-anterior pituitary anomalies-facial dysmorphism syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
